title: The Promise of Bellbird Bay
author: S. M. Hartwell
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
